title: Listener durable ordered transcription providers
description: Listener needs ordered owner-configured transcription providers with Wispr Flow first and OpenAI fallback. Preserve one durable audio artifact, persist each attempt and result before delivery, and keep provider-notification payloads private.
design: Use typed signal-listener and meta-signal-listener vocabulary. Keep provider concurrency and policy state inside Listener; capture a policy generation per job. Use fake providers only in tests and a runtime secret boundary for any real provider credential.
acceptance_criteria: Meta configuration validates and round-trips provider order; durable provider results prevent duplicate delivery; provider failures fall back using the same artifact; cancellation and local-artifact failures do not fall back; degradation and recovery notifications are typed and content-free; Nix checks exercise the behavior.
